title: Optional hosted SPARQL endpoint
context: The corpus is published as GEDCOM X JSON and JSON-LD exports, but researchers accustomed to linked-data workflows benefit from a SPARQL query endpoint that lets them ask federated questions across the corpus and Wikidata simultaneously. This is explicitly an optional, post-M3 enhancement that depends on a steward being willing to host the endpoint. Without a steward hosting commitment, this task should not be started. The endpoint must collect no visitor PII and enforce read-only access.
objective: Scaffold a SPARQL endpoint over the JSON-LD exports of the corpus, configure it for read-only public access with no visitor PII collection, and document deployment requirements so a steward can evaluate whether to host it.
acceptanceCriteria: SPARQL endpoint scaffolded over the JSON-LD corpus exports (e.g., using Apache Jena Fuseki or equivalent open-source triplestore).
Endpoint is read-only; no write or update operations permitted.
No visitor PII collected; no user accounts required.
Deployment documentation describes hosting requirements (CPU, RAM, storage) so a steward can evaluate feasibility.

At least 3 example SPARQL queries documented demonstrating useful genealogical questions (e.g., all persons born in a specific county, all persons with a specific surname who appear in multiple sources).
Endpoint deployment depends on a steward hosting commitment; this task delivers the scaffold and documentation, not a live public endpoint.
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass for any TypeScript/ESM components; endpoint scaffold committed via PR.
output: packages/sparql-endpoint/ — SPARQL endpoint scaffold (configuration + deployment docs + example queries), committed via PR.
